Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning the use of the judicial information system by courts before granting certain orders.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the courts' consultation of the judicialinformation system before granting orders; and adding a new section tochapter 2.28 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 2.28 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Before granting an order under any of the following titles ofthe laws of the state of Washington, the court may consult the judicialinformation system or any related databases, if available, to determinecriminal history or the pendency of other proceedings involving theparties: (a) Granting any temporary or final order establishing a parentingplan or residential schedule or directing residential placement of achild or restraining or limiting a party's contact with a child underTitle 26 RCW; (b) Granting any order regarding a vulnerable child or adult oralleged incapacitated person irrespective of the title or wherecontained in the laws of the state of Washington; p. 1 HB 2196 (c) Granting letters of guardianship or administration or letterstestamentary under Title 11 RCW; (d) Granting any relief under Title 71 RCW; (e) Granting any relief in a juvenile proceeding under Title 13RCW. (2) In the event that the court consults such a database, the courtshall disclose that fact to the parties and shall disclose anyparticular matters relied upon by the court in rendering the decision.A copy of the document relied upon must be filed, as a confidentialdocument, within the court file.
